caption:
Figure 1: Motivation of PreActIR. Existing agentic restoration is largely reactive: tool effects are
observed only after execution, while decisions remain restricted to the available action space. Pre-
ActIR predicts action consequences before execution.
delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed final conceptual figure and independent original/derivative response: trial/retry sequence, fixed-toolbox exclusion, 0.92/0.68/0.18 action predictions, verifier commit/rollback and offline expansion feedback retain their roles. No new verifier-to-failure-case edge is introduced.
